headline_marked: Meta launches [[Pocket]], an AI-powered gaming app
headline: Meta launches Pocket, an AI-powered gaming app
summary: Meta's new app allows users to generate interactive apps and games using AI prompts
details: Meta has launched a new app called Pocket, a creative platform for making and sharing interactive experiences called 'gizmos'. The app allows users to generate small, interactive apps and games using AI prompts.

Pocket was first launched on June 29, 2024, on the App Store and Google Play, according to app intelligence provider Appfigures. The app offers a scrollable feed where users can play with gizmos others have made.
The app's launch was first noticed by Alessandro Paluzzi, a reverse engineer, who published a Play Store screenshot of the app on X. Meta has not yet responded to a request for comment.
Pocket is another example of Meta's push to make AI creation tools more mainstream, extending its earlier efforts, which included AI-generated images and videos.
caption:
Meta enters gaming with AI-powered Pocket app

Meta has launched a new app called Pocket, a creative platform for making and sharing interactive experiences called 'gizmos'. The app allows users to generate small, interactive apps and games using AI prompts.

Pocket was first launched on June 29, 2024, on the App Store and Google Play, according to app intelligence provider Appfigures. The app offers a scrollable feed where users can play with gizmos others have made.

The app's launch was first noticed by Alessandro Paluzzi, a reverse engineer, who published a Play Store screenshot of the app on X. Meta has not yet responded to a request for comment.

Pocket is another example of Meta's push to make AI creation tools more mainstream, extending its earlier efforts, which included AI-generated images and videos.

Source: TechCrunch, DEV
